exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix lease-

exec card --actor worker-a lease acquire staging-db --ttl 30m
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/active.txt
! stderr .

! exec card --actor coordinator lease revoke staging-db --owner worker-b --reason 'owner cannot continue'
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/held.txt
exec card lease show staging-db
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/active.txt
! stderr .

at 2026-07-12T12:05:00Z
exec card --actor coordinator --json lease revoke staging-db --owner worker-a --reason 'owner cannot continue'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/revoked.json
! stderr .
! exec card lease show staging-db
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/missing.txt

! exec card --actor coordinator lease revoke missing --owner worker-a --reason 'owner cannot continue'
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/revoke-missing.txt

exec card --actor worker-a lease acquire expired-slot --ttl 1m
at 2026-07-12T12:06:00Z
! exec card --actor coordinator lease revoke expired-slot --owner worker-a --reason 'owner cannot continue'
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/revoke-expired.txt

! exec card --actor coordinator lease revoke staging-db --owner worker-a --reason ''
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/reason-required.txt

-- golden/active.txt --
staging-db	worker-a	2026-07-12T12:00:00Z	2026-07-12T12:30:00Z
-- golden/held.txt --
error: lease "staging-db" is held by "worker-a" until 2026-07-12T12:30:00Z
-- golden/revoked.json --
{"lease":{"name":"staging-db","owner":"worker-a","acquired_at":"2026-07-12T12:00:00Z","expires_at":"2026-07-12T12:30:00Z"},"revoked_by":"coordinator","reason":"owner cannot continue","revoked_at":"2026-07-12T12:05:00Z"}
-- golden/missing.txt --
error: read lease "staging-db": lease not found
-- golden/revoke-missing.txt --
error: revoke lease "missing": lease not found
-- golden/revoke-expired.txt --
error: revoke lease "expired-slot": lease not found
-- golden/reason-required.txt --
error: reason required
